correctness.rationale: For every integer n>=2, F_n^n=g^{x n}; g is an affine contraction on the lower half and a full invariant tent map on the upper half. The n-fold product mixing yields physical measures from binary rotation classes, with exact basins. Entropy under powers and products gives k log2/n. For each m, two inverse branches of F_n restricted to upper cube have compositions with a strict contracting power and disjoint periodic itineraries, yielding 2^m fixed points exactly; random inverse branch uniqueness proves weak equidistribution. Each critical step is argued in RESULT.md, with bounded finite tests in verify_cyclic_cournot.py. Numerical checks do not certify infinite claims.

value.rationale: The motivating paper exhibits positive-area mixed omega-limit geometry in dimension two and explicitly highlights extension to n dimensions. The theorem gives a natural complete all-dimensional classification of the physically observable ergodic regimes, their exact positive-volume basins and graded entropies, while proving that all dimensions have identical periodic-point counts and zeta and that periodic sampling sees only the all-chaotic maximum-entropy regime. The contrast quantifies why periodic data can be blind to exponentially many physically typical lower-entropy phases; n-dimensional necklace structure is structurally motivated rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
